sources.title: Cohere Transcribe: Open-Source Speech Recognition | Cohere
sources.snippet: Cohere is announcing Transcribe, a state-of-the-art automatic speech recognition (ASR) model that is open source and available today for download. Speech is rapidly becoming a core modality for AI-enabled workloads and automations — from meeting transcription and speech analytics to real-time customer support agents.

sources.title: Cohere Transcribe | Cohere
sources.snippet: Cohere Transcribe is an open source research release of a 2B parameters dedicated audio-in, text-out, automatic speech recognition (ASR) model. The model supports a total of 14 languages.
